svg.title: SONIC general-purpose computer-use architecture
svg.desc: Operator outcome flows through Boss orchestration, local AVCS System 1 pixel perception, SONIC System 2 reasoning, grounded GUI or other appropriate capabilities, and independent Judge review. Safety and evidence controls span the flow.
svg.text: SONIC | General-purpose AI computer user
Architecture overview · components and intended flow, not a universal capability claim
Operator outcome
Desired result · constraints · observable completion evidence
Boss orchestration
Analyze · plan · delegate bounded work · review evidence · replan
No dedicated browser-specialist worker
AVCS | System 1 · local visual perception
Fresh workstation pixels → frame-bound scene and change signals
Pixels stay local; reflex signals do not identify intent, click, or prove success
SONIC | System 2 · ComputerUseAgent reasoning
Goal + bounded AVCS summary + task history → next action proposal
System 2 plans; fresh evidence and action policy gate dispatch
Visible workstation GUI
Discover and use installed desktop applications
Fresh frame → AVCS → reason → grounded action
Ambiguous or stale targets are blocked, never guessed
Other appropriate capabilities
Files · terminal · Git · APIs, when suited to the task
Must not replace an explicitly requested GUI workflow
Headless tasks do not require workstation AVCS frames
Fresh evidence → independent Judge review
Confirm, report partial progress, or mark blocked / unverified
AVCS reflex signals are not semantic grounding or task proof. Tests do not prove real multi-app task completion.
AVCS SDKs, MCP, adapters and experimental models are separate package interfaces; they are not wired into this SONIC runtime path.
